frontmatter.name: builder
frontmatter.description: Autonomous Code Builder & Executor (DeepSeek Executor + Zazen TDD + Fable 5 Traces). Implements the Mandate in an isolated branch/worktree and runs deterministic gates before opening/updating a PR.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash

frontmatter.name: intake-assessor
frontmatter.description: DeepSeek Superagent Eval & coleam00 Intake Assessor. Evaluates incoming GitHub Issues/Discussions/Signals, assigns a concrete Mandate, asks at most ONE concrete question if blocked, or routes to Spec Writer / Builder.

frontmatter.name: reviewer-code
frontmatter.description: Specialist Code & Test Reviewer (coleam00 + Super-Board + Harness2). Audits code quality, edge cases, deterministic tests, and Fable 5 invariants.

frontmatter.name: reviewer-drift
frontmatter.description: Specialist Spec/Docs/Memory Drift Reviewer. Verifies alignment between Mandate, Code, DOX (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md), and WikiLLM (00_Memoire/bundle/).

frontmatter.name: reviewer-security
frontmatter.description: Specialist Security & Supply-Chain Reviewer. Audits secrets, permissions, Dependabot/CodeQL findings, injection vectors, and GitHub Actions security.

frontmatter.name: spec-writer
frontmatter.description: Specification & Architecture Planner (Archon + coleam00 + OpenRig). Turns a Ticket Mandate into an executable spec, acceptance criteria, and DAG before code changes.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Bash
